about_the_game:
"Relic Light" is a pixel-style puzzle-action dungeon game. You will play as an explorer who arrives at the remaining ruins, explores to acquire various skills, solves the complex and diverse puzzles within, and discovers the ultimate secret of the ruins.

Plot

  • The unique atmosphere of science fiction ruins, concealing countless secrets

  • Have a conversation with the machines in the ruins to learn about the stories behind the ruins

Exploration

  • An extremely extensive and interconnected scenario, featuring over 200 meticulously designed levels.

  • Non-linear level exploration in the Galactic Dungeon, free collection, and free decryption

Decryption

  • Multiple unique skills: time travel, quantum transformation, gravity reversal, wind-up toys, etc

  • Skills, mechanisms and scenes are interrelated with each other. One can solve puzzles by crossing between scenes
